pilot_basis: Final single-feature-checkout CPU job 6622263, released split 1/seed 1
method: 60 times each dataset's two-baseline process plus 90 times each dataset's MDN process. Includes measured startup, loading and evaluation; deliberately charges each baseline fit the full paired process.
limits: One split and default settings measured. Width, K, early stopping, filesystem and queue time vary. Reserve is a proposal, not a guaranteed wall time or a completed full grid.
selection: Baseline configurations by validation IBS; MDN configurations by validation NLL. Never choose by test score.
